brandPanel.description: AccelerateOS gives every founder a structured path, AI-powered insights, and the community to grow from zero to raise-ready — faster than ever before.

assess.title: Assess your foundations
assess.desc: Get an honest baseline across 8 startup pillars — product, go-to-market, finance, team, legal, and more — in minutes.

roadmap.title: Build your roadmap
roadmap.desc: Receive a tailored action plan. Work through curated milestones with your mentor and cohort peers to close gaps fast.

execute.desc: Weekly check-ins, live dashboards, and peer benchmarks keep you on track. No milestone falls through the cracks.
